_comment: N-400's monthly spend ceiling, and the copy shown when it is reached.
The SHAPE of this gate is declared in config/apps.yml (flat, one cap for
every caller, because no per-call entitlement of N-400's reaches GP).
The NUMBER lives here so it is a dashboard dial rather than a deploy.
⚠ Per config/remote/OWNERSHIP.md, ADDING this file propagates on boot but
CHANGING the number below does not. To move the cap in production, push it
through PUT /webhooks/admin/config/n400/budget and verify against prod.
Editing this file alone does nothing to a running server.
If this document cannot be read, the gate falls back to the floor in
apps.yml rather than to no cap. Absent config must never mean unlimited.
